transcription_method: Independent visual reading of exact unsolved source folio 67 at 1.8x, with original printed object markers and walls. Source solution is comparison only.
clues: Juno was diagonally next to Skye; their corners touched.
Skye stayed in the Ranger Station.
Eden shared a room with Juno.
Willow was north-west of Bodhi: north and west by any number of squares.
Bodhi was south-west of Moxie: south and west by any number of squares.
Moxie was in the Ranger Station and in row 5.
Remy's room contained exactly one other person.
standard_rules_used: Every witness different row and different column
Use only printed clues and visible map features

interpretations.diagonal_touch: Absolute row difference1 AND absolute column difference1.
interpretations.north_west_any_distance: Strictly smaller column AND smaller row, no distance equality constraint.
interpretations.south_west_any_distance: Strictly smaller column AND larger row.
interpretations.doorways: Room membership follows visible named room boundary; doors do not merge the regions.
interpretations.room_zone_sensitivity: Compute both literal room-only companionship and permissive same-area companionship to test whether Visitor Walkway treatment affects uniqueness.
